exposure: type of hydatidiform mole (complete or partial)
outcome: thyroid function (TSH, fT4, fT3, TT4, TT3, anti-TPO, anti-TG, thyroglobulin)
cohort: 50 patients diagnosed with complete or partial hydatidiform mole.
finding: Patients with complete hydatidiform mole were older, had a higher number of pregnancies, lower TSH levels, and higher fT4 and TT4 levels compared to those with partial hydatidiform mole, with thyroid disease severity increasing with age, parity, beta-HCG level, and mole size.
cross-section timing: During the period of monitoring patients diagnosed with hydatidiform mole.
